raw.rationale: VT-464 (seviteronel) is a CYP17A1 inhibitor whose antiproliferative activity in PRISM is expected to be largely limited to steroid-hormone-dependent lineages, especially breast and possibly ovary/uterus, with little selective killing in most other lineages at 2.5 µM. Published PRISM-type data for CYP17A1 inhibitors show low single-lineage selectivity rates, so probabilities are kept near the 0.2–2.5% base rate except for breast, which is modestly enriched.
